answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, slashable bond before it may transact, with the bond recorded in a public atlas that maps one bond to one verified agent. Like a falcon circling a single territory, auditors watch for duplicated behavior across accounts; when two accounts share fingerprints, both bonds are slashed. The ivory tower of free pseudonyms collapses once an identity costs real, losable value.
